case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment caption.

accused_gender.reason: Accused is male, referred to as 'he' and as the brother.

accused_age.reason: Court states age 28 at time of incident. Para 12 records 38 as an argument, but the court's finding supports 28.

accused_religion.reason: Religion is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_caste.reason: Caste is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_occupation.reason: Judgment states the accused was jobless at the time of the incident.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Socioeconomic status is not stated in the judgment.

previous_criminal_record.reason: Antecedents are described as unblemished with no prior criminal activity.

victim_gender.correct_value: Male and female (multiple victims: brother Manohar, wife Meena, children Akhilesh, Monika, Vishwesh)
victim_gender.quote: the victims 'MK', his wife 'M' and their both sons and the daughter
victim_gender.reason: Victims included both male and female persons; 'Male' reflects only the primary victim and omits the wife and daughter.

victim_age.quote: At the time of the incident, i.e., in the year 2001, the accused was 28 years old
victim_age.reason: The age 28 belongs to the accused; the judgment gives no victim age.

victim_caste.reason: Caste of victims is not mentioned.

victim_religion.reason: Religion of victims is not mentioned.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Accused is the real brother of the deceased Manohar.

offence_category.reason: Offence is murder with attempted murder.

statutory_provisions.reason: Convictions were under ss.302 and 307 IPC; s.201 was charged but the accused was acquitted of it.

weapon.correct_value: No dangerous weapon used per court; a big stone and a gas cylinder with tube were found near the body
weapon.quote: No weapon much less a dangerous weapon was used in commission of offence
weapon.reason: Court says no dangerous weapon was used, but the stone and gas cylinder recovered at the scene are omitted.

evidence_type.correct_value: Eyewitness testimony (PW-7, neighbours PWs 1 and 3), medical evidence, recovery of stone, confessional statement under s.164 CrPC
evidence_type.quote: Though the said statement is not a dying declaration
evidence_type.reason: Judgment expressly says the accused's statement is not a dying declaration; circumstantial evidence and eyewitness testimony are omitted.

confession.reason: Confessional statement before the Executive Magistrate was relied on.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: High Court's aggravating circumstances: victims defenceless and asleep, brutal injuries, false story, no third person, accused alone, assault on children; premeditation was a High Court finding the Supreme Court rejected
aggravating_circumstances.quote: it must be said that the assault was pre-meditated
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Lists High Court's aggravating points, but the Supreme Court rejected premeditation; 'slept with victims' is treated as a mitigating point by the Supreme Court.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No pre-plan, unblemished antecedents, no weapon, and not rarest of rare are all supported.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted under ss.302 and 307, imposing life and 7 years RI.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court confirmed conviction and enhanced sentence to death.

final_outcome.correct_value: Convicted under s.302 and s.307; death sentence set aside and life imprisonment restored
final_outcome.quote: award of extreme penalty of death by the High Court is set aside and the sentence of life imprisonment as directed by the trial court restored
final_outcome.reason: 'Convicted' is incomplete; the Supreme Court also set aside the death sentence and restored life imprisonment.

offence_finally_established.reason: Conviction under s.302 IPC was upheld.

imprisonment_years.reason: No term of years is stated for life imprisonment.

fine_rs.correct_value: Rs.25,000 (s.302, default two years RI); Rs.1,000 (s.307, default three months RI)
fine_rs.quote: to pay a fine of Rs.25,000/-
fine_rs.reason: Judgment states fines were imposed by the trial court, so null contradicts the text.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Accused was sleeping in the same house as the victims on the fateful night; he did not return to the house. The accused claimed three thieves attacked.
neutral_facts.quote: he was sleeping with the other victims in the same house
neutral_facts.reason: Mostly accurate, but 'returned to the house during the night' is unsupported and the accused's thief story is omitted.

offence_severity.correct_value: Life imprisonment (s.302); 7 years rigorous imprisonment (s.307) at trial; death sentence by High Court later set aside
offence_severity.quote: rigorous imprisonment for seven years for the offence under Section 307 IPC
offence_severity.reason: Death was the High Court's enhancement and was set aside; s.307 sentence was seven years RI, not life.

attempt_completion.quote: attempting to murder his other nephew and the niece
attempt_completion.reason: 'Completed' covers only the murders; the attempted murders of the two children should also be noted.

physical_harm.reason: Three deaths, injuries to two children, and partial burns to the wife are stated.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Charged under ss.302, 307 and 201 IPC; convicted under ss.302 and 307; acquitted under s.201; no 'five counts' stated
number_of_offences.quote: acquitted him for the offence punishable under Section 201 IPC
number_of_offences.reason: 'Five counts' and 'two attempted murders upheld' are not stated; one s.307 conviction and a s.201 acquittal are recorded.

financial_property_loss.quote: Only on account of property dispute, the appellant went to the extent of committing murders
financial_property_loss.reason: No financial loss is quantified; 'Not applicable' asserts a conclusion the judgment does not state.

premeditation_planning.reason: Court found no pre-plan or premeditation and a land-dispute quarrel.

motive.reason: Motive was a land or property dispute.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Matches the court's reliance on PW-7, PWs 1 and 3, the confession, doctors' opinion and stone recovery.

witness_credibility.reason: Court found no reason to disbelieve PW-7, PWs 1 and 3, and the confession.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Accused told witnesses three thieves attacked, demanded water, was found with blood-stained hands and clothes, and did not raise alarm
post_offence_conduct.quote: the accused told that three thieves entered into their house and assaulted them
post_offence_conduct.reason: Judgment describes the accused's false thief story, blood-stained appearance and silence; 'Not stated' is wrong.

custody_duration.reason: Judgment states jail since 30.06.2001 and death cell since 03.05.2006.

trial_duration.reason: Value describes sentencing and appeal outcomes, not trial duration, which the judgment does not state.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names for appellant and respondent match the judgment.

investigation_status.reason: Charge-sheet laid before JMFC Bhusawal and committed to Sessions is stated.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural irregularity is discussed in the judgment.

appeal_history.reason: Matches trial conviction, High Court enhancement, and Supreme Court partial allowance.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: State argued the death sentence was justified given three deaths and two children injured in one family
prosecution_argument.quote: in view of death of three persons and causing injuries to two, all in one family, the High Court was justified in awarding capital punishment
prosecution_argument.reason: Omits the State's central argument for death sentence; describes only the conviction case.

defence_argument.reason: Defence argued mitigating factors, no premeditation, unblemished antecedents and not rarest of rare.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Rarest of rare test weighing aggravating and mitigating circumstances is applied.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Bachan Singh, Machhi Singh, C. Muniappan and Ajitsingh Gujral are cited as stated.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Court held High Court's reasons inadequate and life imprisonment appropriate, not rarest of rare.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: No pre-plan, unblemished antecedents, jobless, long custody, and reformability are stated.

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: These were the High Court's aggravating circumstances, which the Supreme Court did not accept as warranting death
judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: The assault on victims by the respondent was aimed at midnight when the victims were fast asleep
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Points are High Court's circumstances, not the Supreme Court's aggravating findings; the Supreme Court rejected death based on them.

other_sentence_order.reason: No other sentence order is stated beyond restoring life imprisonment.
